indicators.context: User agent of Guardian's playwright_screenshot tool: headless Chromium loads every live URL found earlier (httpx, subfinder, nuclei) and every resource on the page, then saves a full-page screenshot for a vision model (tools/playwright_screenshot.py:152-161). Used by the web_visual_pentest workflow when Playwright is i
